notes: How the bot dodges a boss's skills while it watches the fight. Each boss announces a skill with a red line under its HP bar: '<boss> uses <skill> — get out of the red ground!'.
Steps run that many seconds after the bot's screenshot first shows the warning: {key, at, times} taps a key, {hold, at, for} holds one down. The bot reads the warning 0-0.4 s after it appears.

Keys: Q = roll, W/A/S/D = move (W = towards where the camera looks). Timings come from the user's recorded Volcano Turtle King fight (2026-11-04), HP read on every frame: Magma Bite, Earthquake Stomp and Lava Rain hit at +1.7 to +2.15 s, Flame Breath at +1.1 to +1.6 s, Shell Fortress's first hit at +2.84 s. The user's rolls that worked were 1.0-1.8 s after the warning.
This file is read again at every fight, so timings can be tuned while the bot runs.
